initial: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-resolution landscape design presentation board for FitLog native Android app, exactly FOUR complete portrait phone screens side by side, all equally sized, no cropping. Simplified Chinese UI with crisp readable text. Strong Google Material 3 Expressive character: warm near-white #FFFAFF canvas, lavender tonal grouped containers, saturated violet #6950A1 primary pills, pink secondary accents, bold expressive Chinese headlines and oversize numerals, 28-32dp corners, varied shape flower badge used sparingly, Material Symbols icons, spacious 8dp rhythm. Flat polished native Compose appearance, not glassmorphism, no heavy shadows. Android status bars and bottom gesture handles; no iOS controls. Secondary screens have back arrow and no bottom tab bar, except explicitly specified root screen. Use realistic internally consistent demo data and distinguish completed checkmarks from uncompleted prescription. Never make every card a gradient. Match FitLog existing lavender/purple style. Board heading small and elegant; labels below each phone give its role. Board title 'FitLog · 训练记录与执行'. Screen 1: training root history tab '训练', segmented '计划 / 历史' with 历史 selected, four-tab bottom navigation 今日 训练 教练 进展 with 训练 selected. Filter chips 全部 本周 本月, September grouped history cards '9月18日 · 腿部力量', '52 分钟 · 18 组 · 4,480 kg', '9月16日 · 拉日', '9月14日 · 推日'. Screen 2: shared filtered history page '训练记录', back arrow, compact lavender scope banner '9月18日 · 1 次训练', selected date chip, single detailed record card 腿部力量, link '清除筛选'; this exact page is reused for Coach evidence by changing scope banner.
